result: The 12-run Linux comparison confirmed the prior fork head changed mixed-source alias precedence. The repair snapshots supplied Java properties before environment mapping so a legacy system property wins over a current-name environment value, and so explicit system aliases win over environment aliases; the current name remains preferred for same-source conflicts and explicit overwrite mode remains supported. Five focused tests cover conflicts and overwrite behavior. The two-file change was source-reviewed, staged diff --check passed, and the fork ref was verified at the new head. No Windows build or test was run. Previous green receipts cover the previous head only; new proof is pending. The upstream PR head remains 358f13d9fdfaed260143a51100cd5657a582d562 and no public comment was made.
